name: childhood reclaimed
source:
Sam, a freelance programmer, wants to overcome his greatest enemy, anxiety, but life has other plans in store for him in the city he's moved to. Here, Sam will have to think clearly, as it won't just be his adventure... it will also be for a little creature who needs him.

[Translated from [url=https://1zuru.itch.io/childhood-reclaimed-10demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
山姆是一名自由程序员，他想要克服他最大的敌人——焦虑，但在他搬到的城市里，生活还有其他的计划等着他。在这里，山姆必须清楚地思考，因为这不仅仅是他的冒险……这也是一个需要他的小生物的冒险。
